Dear [Madam](/person/133)
After having exhibited the mittens to various very respectful admirers and waiting in vain for my [Cousin](/person/28) to come and see them last week I have decided on sending them to her registered and I am sure she will carefully return them in a short time with many many thanks for the privilege.
Yours thankfully
C.M. Yonge
